questions.q: Identify the tense: 'She has been studying since morning.'

questions.q: Change to passive: 'The teacher praised the boy.'

The boy is praised by teacher.

questions.q: Change to passive: 'They are building a house.'
options: A house was built by them.
A house is being built by them.

questions.q: Change to passive: 'He has completed the project.'
options: The project has been completed by him.

questions.q: Change to active: 'A story will be written by her.'
questions.explanation: Future simple passive 'will be written' becomes active 'will write'.

questions.q: Fill in with correct verb: Time and tide _____ for no man.

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He is senior _____ all his team members.

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: Prefer tea _____ coffee.

He told he could solve this.

The doctor told patient take medicine.

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: She said, 'May God fulfill your wishes!'

She prayed that God might fulfill my wishes.

questions.q: Change to direct speech: He requested her to lend him her book.
